newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent products differentials steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent products differentials steady.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel differentials were steady on Tuesday, but buyers appeared to be emerging for spot barrels in Chicago, traders said.
"They are drawing on Colonial and Group (barrels)," one trader said of the buying interest in Chicago.
Differentials in Chicago were expected to firm on the day due to the buying interest, but were steady in thin trade through the morning, traders said.
BP was rumored in the market after a weekend fire trimmed runs at its 155,000 barrel per day Toledo, Ohio refinery.
Chicago low sulphur diesel was talked 3.0/2.75 cents under the print for October deliveries, with high sulphur 5.50 cents under, traders said.
Chicago unleaded gasoline remained 1.25/1.0 cent under the print for all October timings, with premium 2.75 cents higher, traders said.
Group Three unleaded was talked 0.75/1.0 cent under for prompt and later deliveries, with premium easing to 3.0 cents higher.
Group Three low sulphur diesel was talked 0.50/0.75 cents over the print, with high sulphur 1.0 cent under.
